oe_v49_mp_gp_enabled = {
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
}

oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = {
	oe_v49_mp_gp_enabled = yes
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
	NOT = { country_type = pop }
	NOT = { country_type = building }
}

oe_v49_mp_is_swiss_sphere = {
	OR = {
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:swiss_group }
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				region = region:south_german_region
				region = region:italy_region
				region = region:france_region
			}
		}
	}
}

		capital ?= {

			}
		}
	}
}

		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:amazigh_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:arabic_group }

			}

}

oe_v49_mp_is_caribbean_sphere = {
	OR = {
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				region = region:caribbean_region
				continent = continent:america
			}
		}
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1500
			num_of_ports >= 3
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:iberia_region
					region = region:great_britain_region
					region = region:france_region
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_v49_gp_is_east_asia_sphere = {
	OR = {
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:confucian_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group }
		capital ?= {
			sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
		}
	}
}

oe_v49_gp_is_renaissance_europe_sphere = {
	OR = {
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:italian_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:french_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:german_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:british_group }

		capital ?= {

		}
	}
